en.p: For a quadratic function $f(x)$, the function $g(x)=\{f(x)+2\}e^{f(x)}$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) For $a$ with $f(a)=6$, $g(x)$ has its maximum value at $x=a$.
(B) $g(x)$ has its minimum value at $x=b$ and $x=b+6$.

en.p: When $\alpha$, $\beta$ are the two distinct real roots of the equation $f(x)=0$, find the value of $(\alpha-\beta)^2$. (Here $a$, $b$ are real numbers.) [4 points]
